LegalIntakeStatusController.update
status · expectedVersion 검증

ConsultationMemoController.create
content · followUpItems · expectedVersion
헤더 Idempotency-Key

div.style: color: rgb(230, 237, 246) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
LegalIntakeRecordService.updateStatus
requireManager · 문의 행 잠금
배정 LAWYER / ADMIN 권한 확인

div.style: color: rgb(230, 237, 246) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
같은 상태 → 200 · changed=false · 버전 유지
다른 상태 → expectedVersion 대조
IntakeStatus.canChangeTo → changeStatus

div.style: color: rgb(230, 237, 246) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:

previousStatus · status · changed · version

div.style: color: rgb(230, 237, 246) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
금지 전이 / 오래된 버전 → 409
CLOSED 재개·SUBMITTED 복귀 금지

div.style: color: rgb(230, 237, 246) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:

requireManager · 같은 문의 행 잠금

div.style: color: rgb(230, 237, 246) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:

키 재사용 충돌 / 버전 불일치 → 409
새 요청: memo save · intake.touch · flush

div.style: color: rgb(230, 237, 246) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

id = memoId · intakeId · intakeVersion
